description.blurb: Ryugu is an asteroid whose orbit could bring it very near to Earth. It was visited by the Hayabusa2 mission in 2018, where it sampled the surface and returned the asteroid material to Earth in December of 2020.
description.more: Ryugu measures approximately 1 kilometre (0.62 mi) in diameter and orbits the earth every 1.3 years. The Japanese space agency JAXA launched the Hayabusa2 mission to Ryugu in 2014, and arrived in 2018. The spacecraft spent a year and a half in orbit around the asteroid before returning to Earth to drop off samples of the surface. The spacecraft had multiple objects land on the asteroid and collect data, including two small rovers. The samples of the surface were returned to Earth in December of 2020.
